chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 355 – Ji Ning's Triumph and a Mysterious Visitor
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning wins the Immortal Fortunes Assembly but is parted from Yu Wei. A mysterious powerhouse visits him, hinting at a new destiny beyond the Grand Xia.
og_title: Desolate Era #355 – The Number One's Lonely Victory
og_description: The tournament is over, but the real journey begins. Ji Ning watches his love leave, only to be visited by a being of cosmic power.
twitter_title: Desolate Era – A victory earned, a loved one lost, a mystery begins.
twitter_description: Ji Ning claims first place, but the price is a heartbreaking farewell. A new, terrifyingly powerful visitor arrives at his doorstep.

lore_anchors.definition: The Empyrean God and Pure Yang True Immortal who took the Ragged Daoist as his junior apprentice-brother; depicted as fierce, crude, and deeply affectionate towards his new junior.
An exalted classification within the Ki Refining path, surpassing ordinary True Immortals. They are masters of the Grand Daos and wield immense power in the Three Realms.
In Chinese folklore, one of the legendary Eight Immortals; in Desolate Era, a Pure Yang True Immortal who takes Yu Wei as his direct disciple.
The Celestial Immortal ruler of the Grand Xia Dynasty's vassal state, now sober and serving as Ji Ning's temporary protector.
A Daofather of the Three Realms who accepted the Ragged Daoist (Mu Chuan) as his disciple.
The final group of cultivators in the Immortal Fortunes Assembly, who receive a significant reward of Primordial Liquid and a chance to compete for the top three spots.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of Ji Ning winning first place?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a massive honor that makes his name known across the Grand Xia, but the true prize is the attention it brings from the supreme powers of the Three Realms.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't Ji Ning be with Yu Wei?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She has been chosen as a disciple by Lu Dongbin, a Pure Yang True Immortal. Her cultivation path now lies with him, requiring her to leave the Grand Xia world.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who is the mysterious white-robed man?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is an unfathomably powerful being, likely a True Immortal or Empyrean God, who bypassed all of King Yan's defenses to visit Ji Ning. His identity and purpose are unknown.
In the Immortal Fortunes Assembly, the top twelve cultivators receive ten million jin of Primordial Liquid and gain the right to compete for the final top three spots and selection by a Daofather.
